import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc = bpy.context.scene

def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    m.diffuse_color = (*col, 1)
    return m

M_asph = mat("Asphalt", (0.05,0.05,0.055), 0.9)
M_grass = mat("Grass", (0.08,0.25,0.06), 1.0)
M_kerbR = mat("KerbRed", (0.8,0.05,0.04), 0.6)
M_kerbW = mat("KerbWhite", (0.9,0.9,0.9), 0.6)
M_line = mat("Line", (0.95,0.95,0.95), 0.6)
M_body = mat("CarTeal", (0.0,0.45,0.5), 0.3, 0.3)
M_acc = mat("CarOrange", (1.0,0.35,0.0), 0.35)
M_dark = mat("CarDark", (0.02,0.02,0.02), 0.6)
M_tyre = mat("Tyre", (0.015,0.015,0.015), 0.85)
M_rim = mat("Rim", (0.6,0.6,0.62), 0.3, 0.9)
M_glass = mat("Visor", (0.05,0.08,0.12), 0.1)

# ---- centerline of rounded-rectangle circuit (counter-clockwise) ----
HX, HY, R = 40.0, 25.0, 12.0
def centerline(step=0.5):
    pts = []
    corners = [((HX-R, -HY+R), -90), ((HX-R, HY-R), 0), ((-HX+R, HY-R), 90), ((-HX+R, -HY+R), 180)]
    for (cx, cy), a0 in corners:
        n = 24
        for i in range(n+1):
            a = math.radians(a0 + 90*i/n)
            pts.append(Vector((cx+R*math.cos(a), cy+R*math.sin(a), 0)))
    # densify straights
    out = []
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        p, q = pts[i], pts[(i+1) % len(pts)]
        d = (q-p).length
        k = max(1, int(d/2.0))
        for j in range(k):
            out.append(p.lerp(q, j/k))
    return out
CL = centerline()

def ribbon(name, pts, w_in, w_out, z, material, checker=None):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm = bmesh.new()
    n = len(pts); L=[]; Rr=[]
    for i in range(n):
        t = (pts[(i+1)%n]-pts[i-1]).normalized()
        nrm = Vector((-t.y, t.x, 0))  # left
        L.append(bm.verts.new(pts[i]+nrm*w_out+Vector((0,0,z))))
        Rr.append(bm.verts.new(pts[i]+nrm*w_in+Vector((0,0,z))))
    for i in range(n):
        j=(i+1)%n
        f = bm.faces.new((Rr[i], Rr[j], L[j], L[i]))
        if checker: f.material_index = (i % 2)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); sc.collection.objects.link(ob)
    if checker:
        me.materials.append(checker[0]); me.materials.append(checker[1])
    else:
        me.materials.append(material)
    return ob

W = 6.0
coll = bpy.data.collections.new("Circuit"); sc.collection.children.link(coll)
road = ribbon("Track_Road", CL, -W, W, 0.02, M_asph)
kin = ribbon("Track_KerbInner", CL, W, W+1.0, 0.05, None, (M_kerbR, M_kerbW))
kout = ribbon("Track_KerbOuter", CL, -W-1.0, -W, 0.05, None, (M_kerbR, M_kerbW))
for o in (road, kin, kout):
    sc.collection.objects.unlink(o); coll.objects.link(o)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1, location=(0,0,0))
g = bpy.context.object; g.name="Ground"; g.scale=(160,120,1); g.data.materials.append(M_grass)
sc.collection.objects.unlink(g); coll.objects.link(g)
# start/finish line
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1, location=(-5,-HY,0.03))
s = bpy.context.object; s.name="StartLine"; s.scale=(1.0, 2*W, 1); s.data.materials.append(M_line)
sc.collection.objects.unlink(s); coll.objects.link(s)
# a few corner tyre-wall blocks / cones on outside of the bottom-right corner
for i in range(7):
    a = math.radians(-90 + 90*i/6)
    cx, cy = HX-R, -HY+R
    rr = R + W + 3.0
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=8, radius=0.6, depth=1.0, location=(cx+rr*math.cos(a), cy+rr*math.sin(a), 0.5))
    o = bpy.context.object; o.name=f"TyreWall_{i}"; o.data.materials.append(M_kerbR if i%2 else M_kerbW)
    sc.collection.objects.unlink(o); coll.objects.link(o)
print(len(CL))

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc = bpy.context.scene
M = bpy.data.materials
car = bpy.data.objects.new("RaceCar", None); sc.collection.objects.link(car)
car.empty_display_type='ARROWS'

def mesh_from(name, verts, faces, mat):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces); me.update()
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); sc.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.parent = car; me.materials.append(M[mat]); return ob

def box(name, c, s, mat):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=c)
    o = bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.scale=s
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(M[mat]); o.parent = car; return o

# Body: wedge hull, front = +X. Sections (x, half-width, z_bottom, z_top)
secs = [(2.3,0.25,0.15,0.30),(1.4,0.45,0.12,0.45),(0.4,0.55,0.12,0.60),(-0.9,0.85,0.12,0.62),(-1.9,0.6,0.15,0.70)]
v=[]; 
for x,hw,zb,zt in secs:
    v += [(x,-hw,zb),(x,hw,zb),(x,hw,zt),(x,-hw,zt)]
f=[]
for i in range(len(secs)-1):
    a=i*4; b=a+4
    for k in range(4):
        f.append((a+k, b+k, b+(k+1)%4, a+(k+1)%4))
f.append((0,3,2,1)); n=(len(secs)-1)*4; f.append((n,n+1,n+2,n+3))
body = mesh_from("Car_Body", v, f, "CarTeal")
for p in body.data.polygons: pass
# recalc normals
bm=bmesh.new(); bm.from_mesh(body.data); bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces); bm.to_mesh(body.data); bm.free()

# sidepods (orange)
for sgn in (-1,1):
    box(f"Car_Sidepod_{'L' if sgn>0 else 'R'}", (-0.6, sgn*0.95, 0.35), (1.6,0.35,0.4), "CarOrange")
# cockpit / canopy
cv=[(0.6,-0.32,0.6),(0.6,0.32,0.6),(-0.5,0.38,0.62),(-0.5,-0.38,0.62),(0.0,-0.25,0.92),(0.0,0.25,0.92),(-0.7,0.3,0.95),(-0.7,-0.3,0.95)]
cf=[(0,1,5,4),(1,2,6,5),(2,3,7,6),(3,0,4,7),(4,5,6,7),(0,3,2,1)]
can = mesh_from("Car_Canopy", cv, cf, "Visor")
# airbox fin
box("Car_Fin", (-1.4,0,0.9), (1.0,0.08,0.45), "CarOrange")
# front wing + endplates
box("Car_FrontWing", (2.25,0,0.12), (0.45,2.0,0.06), "CarOrange")
for sgn in (-1,1): box(f"Car_FWPlate_{sgn}", (2.25,sgn*1.0,0.2), (0.5,0.05,0.22), "CarDark")
# rear wing
box("Car_RearWing", (-2.15,0,1.15), (0.5,1.7,0.07), "CarOrange")
box("Car_RearWing2", (-2.3,0,1.3), (0.3,1.7,0.05), "CarTeal")
for sgn in (-1,1):
    box(f"Car_RWPlate_{sgn}", (-2.2,sgn*0.87,1.05), (0.7,0.05,0.6), "CarDark")
    box(f"Car_RWStrut_{sgn}", (-2.0,sgn*0.25,0.85), (0.1,0.05,0.5), "CarDark")
# stripe on nose
box("Car_Stripe", (1.6,0,0.43), (1.4,0.18,0.04), "CarOrange")
# wheels
wheels=[]
for x,r,w in ((1.55,0.36,0.35),(-1.45,0.42,0.45)):
    for sgn in (-1,1):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=12, radius=r, depth=w, location=(x, sgn*(1.0+w/2), r), rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        t=bpy.context.object; t.name=f"Car_Wheel_{'F' if x>0 else 'R'}{'L' if sgn>0 else 'R'}"; t.data.materials.append(M["Tyre"]); t.parent=car
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6, radius=r*0.55, depth=w+0.02, location=t.location, rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        h=bpy.context.object; h.name=t.name+"_Rim"; h.data.materials.append(M["Rim"]); h.parent=car
# flat shading for low-poly look
for o in car.children:
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
print([o.name for o in car.children])

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc = bpy.context.scene
HX, HY, R = 40.0, 25.0, 12.0
X0 = -20.0; L1 = (HX-R) - X0; L2 = math.pi*R/2; L3 = 23.0
TOT = L1+L2+L3
def at(s):
    if s <= L1: return Vector((X0+s, -HY, 0)), 0.0
    s -= L1
    if s <= L2:
        a = -math.pi/2 + s/R
        return Vector((HX-R+R*math.cos(a), -HY+R+R*math.sin(a), 0)), a+math.pi/2
    s -= L2
    return Vector((HX, -HY+R+s, 0)), math.pi/2

car = bpy.data.objects["RaceCar"]
cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new("ChaseCam"); cam_data.lens = 32; cam_data.clip_end = 500
cam = bpy.data.objects.new("ChaseCam", cam_data); sc.collection.objects.link(cam)
tgt = bpy.data.objects.new("ChaseCam_Target", None); sc.collection.objects.link(tgt)
tc = cam.constraints.new('TRACK_TO'); tc.target = tgt; tc.track_axis='TRACK_NEGATIVE_Z'; tc.up_axis='UP_Y'

sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end = 1, 120
sc.render.fps = 24; sc.render.fps_base = 1
CAM_BACK = 8.0
prev_yaw = None
for f in range(1, 121):
    u = (f-1)/119
    s = u*TOT
    p, yaw = at(s)
    car.location = p; car.rotation_euler = (0, 0, yaw)
    car.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f); car.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=f)
    cp, cy = at(max(0.0, s - CAM_BACK)) if s - CAM_BACK >= 0 else (p - Vector((CAM_BACK - 0, 0, 0)), 0)
    if s - CAM_BACK < 0: cp = Vector((X0 + s - CAM_BACK, -HY, 0))
    cam.location = cp + Vector((0, 0, 2.6))
    cam.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
    fwd = Vector((math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw), 0))
    tgt.location = p + fwd*2.5 + Vector((0, 0, 0.8))
    tgt.keyframe_insert("location", frame=f)
for ob in (car, cam, tgt):
    for fc in ob.animation_data.action.fcurves if hasattr(ob.animation_data.action, "fcurves") else []:
        for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation = 'LINEAR'

# wheel spin
for w in [o for o in car.children if o.name.startswith("Car_Wheel")]:
    r = 0.36 if "_F" in w.name else 0.42
    w.rotation_mode = 'XYZ'
    w.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=1)
    w.rotation_euler.y += TOT / r
    w.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=120)

sc.camera = cam
try:
    sc.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
except TypeError:
    sc.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = 1280, 720
sc.render.resolution_percentage = 100
sc.frame_set(1)
print(TOT, sc.render.engine, bpy.app.version_string, type(car.animation_data.action))
